cohort: 80 singleton pregnant women in spontaneous labor who had a first trimester ultrasound and estimated crown rump length attending Katuri Medical College in Guntur, India, from November 2019 to November 2021
finding: Amniotic fluid optical density (AFOD) correlated with newborn functional maturity, with an AFOD of 1.058 ± 0.36 indicating functional maturity.
birth_weight: recorded but not specified in the abstract
